name: aws_route_table_association
description: Associates a subnet or gateway with a route table

route_table_id.name: route_table_id
route_table_id.description: ID of the route table to associate

subnet_id.name: subnet_id
subnet_id.description: Subnet ID to associate (mutually exclusive with gateway_id)

gateway_id.name: gateway_id
gateway_id.description: Gateway ID to associate (mutually exclusive with subnet_id)
